outputs.L1: A food processing system comprises a recipient configured to receive food ingredients and a lid having upward-facing and downward-facing sides configured to engage with the perimeter of the recipient, thereby at least partially closing the recipient. The system further comprises a driving arrangement confined within a casing and adapted to drive a tool support arranged inside the recipient. The lid includes a single lid opening, advantageously having a generally circular form and disposed, for example, centrally relative to the lid. The upward-facing side of the lid includes a first surface extending over a generally outer region of the lid and a second surface extending around the opening and positioned at a lower level relative to the first surface. The lid further includes a flow-guiding unit arranged next to the lid opening and adapted to provide a streamlined flow of a fluid poured onto the second surface into the recipient when the lid is placed thereon.
outputs.L2: A food processing apparatus includes a container designed to hold food ingredients and a lid with upper and lower faces that is shaped to cooperate with the container’s rim so that the container is at least partly covered. The system also has a drive assembly enclosed in a housing and configured to operate a tool holder positioned inside the container. The lid has one lid aperture, preferably of substantially circular shape and located, for example, near the center of the lid. On the upper face of the lid, a first surface extends over a generally outer area, while a second surface surrounds the aperture and is formed at a lower height than the first surface. The lid additionally includes a flow-directing element positioned adjacent to the lid aperture and arranged to produce a smooth flow of liquid poured onto the second surface into the container when the lid is mounted on it.
outputs.L3:
The food processing system includes a recipient configured to receive food ingredients and a lid arranged to at least partially close the recipient during use. The recipient may be shaped to hold solid, liquid, or semi-liquid ingredients, while the lid helps limit splashing and assists in directing ingredients into the interior of the recipient.

The system further includes a driving arrangement housed within a casing. The driving arrangement is adapted to drive a tool support positioned inside the recipient. The tool support may be configured to carry or connect to a processing tool, such as a blade, whisk, kneading element, or mixing accessory, so that food ingredients placed in the recipient can be processed when the driving arrangement is activated.

The lid comprises a single, generally circular opening. This opening may be located substantially at the center of the lid, although other positions are also possible depending on the configuration of the system. The opening allows ingredients, especially liquids or pourable substances, to be introduced into the recipient while the lid remains in place.

On an upper side of the lid, the lid includes a first outer surface and a lower second surface extending around the opening. The second surface is positioned below the first outer surface and surrounds the opening so as to define a region through which poured fluid can be directed toward the interior of the recipient.

A flow guiding unit is arranged near the opening of the lid. This flow guiding unit is configured to streamline fluid that is poured onto the second surface, guiding the fluid through the opening and into the recipient. By directing the flow in a controlled manner, the flow guiding unit helps reduce splashing, spilling, or unintended accumulation of liquid on the lid, thereby improving the ease and cleanliness of adding ingredients during operation of the food processing system.
outputs.L4:
A food processing system is designed to allow ingredients to be added in a controlled and clean manner during preparation. The system includes a recipient or processing vessel for receiving food ingredients, a lid fitted to the recipient, and an internal tool support arranged to carry or drive a food processing tool inside the recipient. The lid is configured to remain in place during operation, helping to reduce splashing, contamination, and accidental contact with moving parts.

The lid has a single central opening through which ingredients, particularly liquids or other flowable materials, may be introduced into the recipient. This opening is positioned above the interior of the recipient and is associated with an enclosed drive arrangement for the internal tool support. By enclosing the drive arrangement, the system helps protect the mechanical components from direct exposure to food materials while also improving hygiene and ease of cleaning.

A recessed surface is formed in the lid around or adjacent to the central opening. This recessed surface acts as a collecting and guiding region for ingredients poured onto the lid. Instead of spreading across the lid surface or spilling over the sides, the poured material is directed toward the central opening. An adjacent flow-guiding unit further assists this movement by channeling the fluid into the opening and then into the recipient below.

In use, a user may pour liquid ingredients, sauces, oils, water, milk, or other flowable food materials onto the recessed area of the lid. The shape of the recessed surface and the flow-guiding unit cooperate to guide the material smoothly and efficiently into the recipient. This allows ingredients to be added while the lid remains securely mounted, maintaining a cleaner working environment and reducing interruption of the food processing operation.

The arrangement is particularly useful for blending, mixing, chopping, kneading, emulsifying, or similar food preparation processes in which additional ingredients need to be introduced gradually. Because the lid does not need to be removed for filling, the system improves safety and convenience. At the same time, the central opening and guiding features provide a predictable flow path, helping ensure that ingredients enter the processing chamber directly rather than accumulating on the lid or escaping outside the vessel.

Overall, the system provides an improved filling structure for a food processor or similar appliance. By combining a recipient, a fitted lid with a single central opening, an enclosed internal drive arrangement, and a recessed flow-guiding surface, the system enables clean, directed ingredient addition while preserving the protective and functional benefits of a closed lid.
outputs.L5:
**A Food Processing**

A food processing facility plays an important role in turning raw ingredients into safe, convenient, and ready-to-use food products. Through methods such as washing, cutting, cooking, freezing, drying, packaging, and preserving, food processing helps extend shelf life and reduce waste. It also makes food easier to transport and store while maintaining quality and safety standards.

Modern food processing uses advanced technology to ensure cleanliness, consistency, and efficiency. Machines can sort fruits and vegetables, mix ingredients, seal packages, and check products for quality. These processes help provide consumers with a wide range of foods, from canned vegetables and frozen meals to dairy products, snacks, and beverages.

Food processing is essential for meeting the needs of a growing population. When done responsibly, it can support food safety, improve nutrition, and make healthy foods more accessible. At the same time, companies must focus on sustainability, reducing energy use, minimizing packaging waste, and using high-quality ingredients to protect both people and the environment.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract for a food processing appliance with a bowl, lid, central opening, recessed surface, and flow-guiding feature for pouring liquids into the bowl.
counterfactuals.output: A food processing appliance includes a bowl defining a processing chamber and a lid removably positionable on the bowl. The lid includes a central opening configured to receive a processing tool, ingredient pusher, or access cover, and an upper recessed surface surrounding at least a portion of the central opening. A flow-guiding feature is formed in or on the recessed surface and is configured to direct liquid introduced onto the lid toward the central opening for delivery into the bowl. The flow-guiding feature may include one or more sloped surfaces, channels, ribs, grooves, or dams arranged to collect, meter, or guide liquid flow while reducing spillage across the lid. The recessed surface and flow-guiding feature cooperate to permit liquids, such as oil, water, sauces, or other ingredients, to be poured into the bowl during operation of the appliance without removing the lid.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Convert the following concept into European patent application wording: food processor recipient, casing-confined drive arrangement, tool support inside the recipient, lid with one generally circular aperture, stepped top surface, and streamlined liquid inlet guide.
counterfactuals.output:
A food processor comprising:

a recipient for receiving foodstuff to be processed;

a casing enclosing a drive arrangement;

a tool support arranged within the recipient and operatively connectable to the drive arrangement for driving a food processing tool;

and a lid configured to close an upper opening of the recipient,

wherein the lid comprises a top wall having a generally circular aperture extending therethrough for introducing liquid into the recipient,

wherein an upper surface of the lid is formed as a stepped surface comprising at least a first surface portion and a second surface portion arranged at different heights, and

wherein the lid further comprises a liquid inlet guide associated with the aperture, the liquid inlet guide being streamlined so as to guide liquid introduced through the aperture towards the interior of the recipient while reducing splashing and/or flow turbulence.

In one embodiment, the liquid inlet guide comprises a smoothly curved guide surface extending from the aperture towards the interior of the recipient.

In one embodiment, the generally circular aperture is provided in an elevated portion of the stepped top surface.

In one embodiment, the liquid inlet guide is integrally formed with the lid.

In one embodiment, the lid is removably mountable on the recipient and is configured to prevent access to the tool support during operation of the drive arrangement.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write an invention summary for a food processing system whose lid partially closes a mixing vessel and includes a lowered surface around a central opening plus a flow guiding unit to direct poured fluid into the vessel.
counterfactuals.output:
An embodiment of the invention provides a food processing system including a mixing vessel and a lid configured to be positioned on the mixing vessel. The lid partially closes the mixing vessel while defining a central opening through which ingredients may be introduced during operation. The lid includes a lowered surface region surrounding the central opening, the lowered surface being arranged to receive liquid or other flowable ingredients poured onto the lid.

A flow guiding unit is provided in association with the lowered surface and the central opening. The flow guiding unit is configured to direct fluid received on the lowered surface toward and through the central opening and into the interior of the mixing vessel. In this manner, poured liquid can be guided reliably into the vessel while reducing spillage, splashing, or accumulation of liquid on the lid.

In some embodiments, the flow guiding unit may include one or more inclined surfaces, channels, ribs, funnels, or deflecting structures formed integrally with or attached to the lid. The lowered surface may extend annularly around the central opening and may be shaped to collect fluid from different pouring directions. The central opening may also receive a removable insert, measuring cup, cap, or ingredient pusher, while still allowing controlled addition of fluid when the insert is removed or partially displaced.

The system may be used with a blender, food processor, mixer, cooker-mixer, or similar appliance having a rotating tool within the mixing vessel. By providing a lid with a lowered receiving surface and a flow guiding unit, the system enables convenient addition of liquids during food processing, improves cleanliness, and facilitates controlled introduction of ingredients into the vessel without requiring complete removal of the lid.
counterfactuals.label: cf_5
